title: Introduce cross-run signal fuser and attenuated quarantine gate
author: Priya Sundaram
release_notes: Add cross-run signal fusion to reduce transient false positives and a quarantining gate that attenuates over time to avoid noisy rollbacks. Backwards compatible with existing CI hooks.
description: Motivation: we have seen an increase in spurious regression alerts caused by transient noise across single eval runs. This PR introduces a 'cross-run signal fuser' that aggregates evidence across multiple recent eval runs and an 'attenuated quarantine gate' that quarantines prompt subsets but decays the quarantine based on evidence accumulation. Summary: - Adds a fusion layer that computes weighted consensus scores for prompt-level failures across N prior runs (configurable window) and exposes an explainable importance vector per prompt. - Introduces a quarantine gate that accepts fused signals and applies attenuation (time-decay + evidence boosting) before triggering CI hard-blocks. - Exposes a new explainable regression annotator that writes per-prompt provenance (seed, model-version, cohort) and a salience score used by oncall to triage. Implementation notes: the fusion algorithm is implemented in eval_harness/orchestrator/signal_fuser.py, uses a Bayesian smoothing prior to handle sparse counts, and is intentionally conservative (requires sustained signal to flip state). The quarantine gate lives in ci/hooks/quarantine_gate.py and is inserted as an optional stage in the regression pipeline ci/pipelines/regression_check.yml. Configuration: defaults are conservative (window=5 runs, min_evidence=3, attenuation_halflife=7 days) and overridable via linear keys in the job config. Testing and validation: unit tests cover scoring math and attenuation behavior tests/test_signal_fuser.py and integration smoke in tests/integration/test_quarantine_flow.py. I ran the new pipeline against historical snapshots (backfill) to validate false-positive rate declined by ~42% on a sampled dataset. Backwards compatibility: the new hook is opt-in; default behavior is no gating unless teams opt into the quarantine stage. Rollout plan: 1) Merge as opt-in; 2) Enable for a small canary of prompt-sets for 72h; 3) Expand to 25% of critical prompt sets with monitoring; 4) Full enable after 2 weeks if signal looks stable. Related: addresses ENG-6733 and is part of mitigation for SUP-2109 incident. Links: internal runbook and evaluation notebooks added under examples/diagnostics. Checklist: - [x] Implementation for fusion and gate - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Backfill run against 30 days of snapshots - [x] Docs: short explainer + how to opt-in - [x] Canaries and rollout plan
